title.hr: Obnova pod opterećenjem i drugi kvar
title.en: Rebuild under load and the second failure

concept.hr: Duga obnova, nečitljiv sektor, izgubljeno polje
concept.en: A long rebuild, an unreadable sector, a lost array

summary.hr: Otkaži disk u RAID 5 ili 6 i prati obnovu pojas po pojas: sati bez zalihosti, pročitani bitovi i nečitljiv sektor koji polje sruši ili ne.
summary.en: Fail a disk in RAID 5 or 6 and follow the rebuild band by band: hours without redundancy, bits read, and the unreadable sector that sinks the array or not.
